card.name: Words inside lists of fistula and ECG findings
card.fires_on: Small linking words or commas inside a list of medical findings, such as 'including' after 'Fistulas,' or the comma after 'tracheoesophageal'. Also 'ero' inside 'enterohepatic'.

modes.label: Including in fistula lists
modes.description: The word 'including' or a comma inside the list of fistula types in perforation and fistula warnings.
modes.example: . 5.3 Perforations and Fistulas OMCAZIO can cause gastrointestinal (GI) perforations and fistulas. Fistulas,<< including>> fatal cases, occurred in 1%

modes.label: Linking words in descriptive lists
modes.description: Words such as 'progressive', 'even' or 'encourage' that continue a list of effects after 'and'.

modes.example: 7.1. Effects of Other Drugs on CHOLBAM Drug interactions with CHOLBAM mainly relate to agents capable of interrupting the ent<<ero>>hepatic circulation of bile acids.
